race.description: Aldebaran Park Bill Collins Trotters Sprint (G1)
race.comment: LOVEMETO NZ (6) was a big improver when second-up in the Dullard Cup last week, working from a similar draw to this but proving too good by 1.7m. Drops in trip but has a consistent record at this distanced and should be further improved third up. GOTFEELINGSYOUKNOW (5) was first up since his second in the Inter Dominion final when fourth to Lovemeto last week. Proven second-up so should be improved and the distance drop won't hurt as he is a three-time winner at this journey. GATESYS GEM (2) led and faded as a hot favourite last week but won twice in a row here prior including a Vicbred Final. Draws to go forward again and she is suited dropping to a distance where she is three from three so can bounce back. I AM WILMA (1) kicked off her campaign with a couple of wins here before a second to GATESYS GEM from a tough draw last start. Kept up to the mark with a trial win and draws for a soft run. Tricky draw for ROCKINWITHATTITUDE (9) but she is reliable so respect.
